placements.role: Provides satellite-derived soil-moisture data for flood-risk monitoring and hydrological warning.

role_evidence.claim: Spire used near-real-time satellite soil-moisture data to identify the hydrological tipping point in China's July 2025 floods.

data_tier_basis: US SEC filer, CIK 1816017: dual-source price plane (price_status AGREED, yfinance and stockanalysis agreeing to the cent at 13.17 on 2026-08-28), SEC companyfacts fundamentals, and a full ACIS quality computation (piotroski, beneish, altman, reverse_dcf, market_cap) already on disk in data/market/SPIR.json, the most complete local store of the three market-file issuers profiled this run.
opportunity_tier_basis: Written COMPLETE at O2 by run profile --campaign CAMP-20260830-01 on 2026-09-01. Not examined by run selection; O1 is a later, separate command per method section 6A.
business_summary: Spire Global, Inc. is a US, NYSE-listed (SPIR) space-data and analytics company operating a constellation of small satellites. It used near-real-time satellite soil-moisture data to identify the hydrological tipping point in China's July 2025 floods, which is the mapped exposure to the tibet-mega-dam chain's riparian-risk-monitoring link.

exposure_summary.narrative: Spire Global sits on riparian-risk-monitoring, scored QUIET. The company's own flood-analysis writeup describes soil-moisture data used to identify a real 2025 China flood tipping point, but no Tibet-basin-specific or dam-specific revenue percentage is disclosed or sourced; the link's own bottleneck note flags revenue concentration per listed name as unproven across the whole link.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: no revenue percentage tied to the tibet-mega-dam exposure is sourced for Spire Global this run; see data_gaps.

crowdedness_caveats: Spire Global sits on a link scored QUIET (see placements above); the link's own note flags unproven per-name revenue concentration.

data/market/SPIR.json carries no pcs (positioning/crowdedness-signal) block, so this profile cannot independently corroborate the link-level crowdedness score with issuer-level analyst-coverage or institutional-ownership figures.
Piotroski state WEAK (3/9) and Altman state DISTRESS on data/market/SPIR.json quality: the underlying business shows genuine financial-quality weakness independent of this chain's exposure.

catalysts.claim: Spire used near-real-time satellite soil-moisture data to identify the hydrological tipping point in China's July 2025 floods.
catalysts.basis: Mapping placement role_evidence carried into this profile; not independently re-fetched this run.

risks.claim: Spire Global's FY2025 operating margin is -134.1% and FCF margin is -129.4% on companyfacts data, and data/market/SPIR.json quality reports Altman state DISTRESS and Piotroski state WEAK (3 of 9), despite a positive FY2025 net income (51305000) that likely reflects a non-operating item rather than a profitability turnaround.
risks.source_name: ACIS quality computation (financetoolkit models), read from data/market/SPIR.json quality block

data_gaps: Leverage (net_debt_to_ebitda) is NULL: FY2025 EBITDA is negative, making a debt/EBITDA ratio not a meaningful leverage measure, and the one total_debt reading on file is fifteen months stale relative to the cash reading it would be netted against.

Reverse DCF is NOT_APPLICABLE per the source quality block: base-year FCF is negative, so no implied growth rate is solvable; recorded as NULL here per method section 1 (NULL is never estimated or interpolated).
No Tibet-basin-specific or dam-specific revenue percentage is disclosed or sourced for Spire Global.
No further PENDING request queued this run: price, fundamentals and quality are all already on disk for SPIR.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/SPIR.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/SPIR.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (71553000 / 80268000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31: revenue declined over the window.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/SPIR.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: Operating income -95981000 divided by revenue 71553000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/SPIR.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Operating cash flow -59829000 minus capital expenditure 32776000, divided by revenue 71553000, for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, all from companyfacts; matches data/market/SPIR.json quality.derived.fcf (-92605000) exactly. operating_cash_flow_to_net_income is omitted (not written as NULL) because net income for FY2025 (51305000, positive) paired against negative operating cash flow (-59829000) produces a ratio that inverts sign relative to both inputs and would mislead; fcf_margin is the informative field here.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: net debt to EBITDA is not written as a computed value for Spire Global: EBITDA for fiscal year 2025 (operating income -95981000 plus depreciation 12405000 = -83576000) is negative, which makes a debt/EBITDA ratio not a meaningful leverage measure regardless of the numerator; total_debt itself is also a single stale point (2025-03-31: 0) roughly fifteen months before the cash reading (2026-06-30: 38814000) it would be netted against.

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/SPIR.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 3 (state WEAK, 9 of 9 input criteria found) computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/SPIR.json quality.piotroski.

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/SPIR.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -4.61 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN (12 of 12 inputs found), computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/SPIR.json quality.beneish. A more negative M-score is the non-manipulator reading.

market_cap.source_name: ACIS quality computation (financetoolkit models), read from data/market/SPIR.json quality block
market_cap.basis: Read from data/market/SPIR.json quality.derived.market_cap, computed by the ACIS quality engine from price 13.17 (2026-08-28) and shares 31950850 (as of 2025-12-31, source fundamentals.shares_fy).

price_to_sales.source_name: ACIS quality computation (financetoolkit models), read from data/market/SPIR.json quality block
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 420792694.5 divided by latest-fiscal-year revenue 71553000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: reverse-DCF implied FCF CAGR is NOT_APPLICABLE for Spire Global per data/market/SPIR.json quality.reverse_dcf: base-year free cash flow is not positive (-92605000), and a growth rate solved on a negative base is meaningless.

horizon_spread.basis: reverse-DCF horizon spread cannot be computed for Spire Global with the base CAGR solve unavailable for the reason above.

disposition.basis: The most data-complete of the three market-file profiles written this run: real SEC companyfacts fundamentals and a full ACIS quality computation give 8 of 10 canonical fields real values, with only leverage and reverse-DCF NULL, both on genuine measurement grounds (negative EBITDA, negative base FCF) rather than a missing local store. Retained rather than advanced because the underlying business shows real financial-quality weakness (Piotroski WEAK, Altman DISTRESS) and the link itself is scored QUIET with unproven per-name revenue concentration. Selection is a separate command and is not run here.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only (cash_conversion writes only fcf_margin). VERIFIED covers figures read directly from companyfacts or the quality engine's own output (latest_fy revenue, piotroski, beneish_state). INFERRED covers figures computed from companyfacts or the quality block with the derivation named in each basis (growth, margins, cash_conversion, valuation x2). NULL covers leverage and both reverse-DCF fields, each traced to a stated measurement reason (negative EBITDA, stale/mismatched debt reading, negative base FCF) rather than a missing store.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
